sentences.text: Bench: T. Vinod Kumar  THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE T. VINOD KUMAR  WRIT PETITION Nos.25836 and 25866 of 2024 COMMON ORDER:
Since the lis involved in these Writ Petitions is similar, they are being disposed of by this common order.

2. These Writ Petitions are filed questioning the action of the respondent authorities in not considering the application submitted by the petitioners seeking reference to the authority under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 ( for short 'the Act').
3.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: However, today when the Writ Petitions are taken up for hearing, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing on behalf of the respondent authorities would submit that during the pendency of the present Writ Petitions, the authorities have referred the application submitted by the petitioners for determination of market value to the authority constituted under Section 64 of the Act on 28-09-2024.

4. Learned Government Pleader further submits that since the authorities have now made reference,
the grievance of the petitioners in the present Writ Petitions stands redressed.

5. By stating as above, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition has placed before this Court a copy of the proceedings Rc.No.B/1019/2015 dated 28-09-2024, whereby reference has been made to the authority constituted under Section 64 of the Act.

6. In view of the above said submission and having regard to the reference made by the authorities on 28-09-2024, this Court is of the view that the grievance of the petitioners stands redressed, and no further orders are necessary.
7. Accordingly, these Writ Petitions are closed.
8. As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions pending if any shall stand closed.
_ _ _ T. VINOD KUMAR, J Date: 10.01.2025 Vsv Datla Vijay Kumar vs The State Of Telangana on 10 January, 2025
